title: Caustic
tagline: Sixty holes. The ball is light, and the glass has opinions.
description: Mini-golf where the ball is a photon. It travels dead straight until it crosses into water, glass or something denser, and then it bends — gently or hard, depending on what it went into. Hit the glass at too shallow an angle and it will not go in at all, it will skid off. A prism splits white light into red, green and blue, and those three have to find three different cups. Sixty holes, each one generated and then proved sinkable before it was allowed into the course.
author: HexCave
controls: Drag back to aim and set power
howToPlay: Drag back and let go. The ball is light, so glass bends it.
Pink glass splits white into three, each needing its own cup.
Sixty holes, every one proved sinkable.
goal: Sink every cup on each of the sixty holes, in as few strokes as you can. Par is the proved best for that hole.

1.0.0.notes: First release. Sixty holes, each proved sinkable.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.

1.1.1.notes: Hints keep clear of each game’s own controls.
